_comment: Dashboard-owned paper limits. Paper only. This file is not the picks database. Old defaults: edge bar 0.08 after the fee, max open positions 4, daily loss stop $50. New defaults: edge bar 0.04 after the fee, max open positions 12, daily loss stop $150. The daily loss stop stays. A bad paper day still ends. The hour is counted toward 12. That count does not waive the edge. A paper buy still needs the edge after the fee. Under 80%, a paper stake is about $20. At 80% or higher, a paper stake is $20 to $100. The fill buys enough contracts to land near that stake.
